from click._termui_impl import get_pager_file

runner = CliRunner()
with runner.isolation():
    print("before get_pager_file:", sys.stdout.closed)
    with get_pager_file() as f:
        print("f is:", f)
        print("f.buffer is:", getattr(f, "buffer", None))
        print("sys.stdout is:", sys.stdout)
        print("sys.stdout.buffer is:", sys.stdout.buffer)
        f.write("hello")
    print("after get_pager_file context manager:")
    print("sys.stdout.closed:", sys.stdout.closed)
    import gc
    gc.collect()
    print("after gc:", sys.stdout.closed)
